core_capability: Real Agnes can actively acquire additional professional observation: after Basic Diagnosis, Agnes decides whether information is sufficient; if not, it requests a Probe (PCA_ORIENTATION or CHEAP_LOCAL_ICP); Python validates (whitelist+dedup+quota MAX_PROBES_PER_RUN=2) and dispatches; probe observation is fed back; Agnes re-decides (possibly requesting the other probe), then selects a formal method + parameter policy. Python has NO automatic probe trigger branch.
probes_implementation_owner: src/agent_probes.py: run_pca_orientation_probe (numpy PCA on 1000-pt samples, eigh 3x3) and run_cheap_local_icp_probe (identity init, 5 ICP iterations, no global init, no SOR, icp_max_corr_scale=2.0 fixed low-cost setting). Registered in PROBE_DISPATCH; independent from agent_tools.TOOL_REGISTRY (registration algorithms).
probe_decision_owner: Real Agnes LLM (agnes-3.0-flash) via AGH subagent_fork. requested_probe appears in agnnes_raw_decision_NN.json. Probe ORDER (PCA then ICP in the smoke trace) was chosen by two independent Agnes decisions, NOT by Python.

python_probe_guardrails.quota: MAX_PROBES_PER_RUN = 2 (legal guardrail; prevents infinite probing). No probe ORDER constraint in Python.
python_probe_guardrails.dedup: validate_decision(probes_already_run=...) rejects re-requesting an already-executed probe

pca_ambiguity_handling: Per-axis greedy sign disambiguation (v <- ±v maximizing dot product with source frame) + enumeration of 6 axis permutations taking argmax |trace(R)| (max geometric consistency). LOW confidence + rotation_estimate_deg=null when near-isotropic/symmetric (λ0/λ1<1.25 & λ1/λ2<1.5) or near-planar (λ0/λ1<1.25) or near-line (λ1/λ2<1.25) on either side. GT never used to disambiguate.

cheap_icp_cost_vs_formal.wall_time_l2_seed_202: probe ≈0.32s vs formal LOCAL_ICP ≈5.06s (~16x, ~6% of formal cost)
cheap_icp_cost_vs_formal.conclusion: Cheap ICP Probe is genuinely low-cost; B2B does NOT need NEEDS_REDESIGN

gt_leakage: PASS. Neither probe reads gt_transform/rotation_error/translation_error/level label. All 12 agnnes_*.json files in B2B smoke evidence scanned: 0 hits for banned keywords. Evaluator (agent_evaluator) runs only after Agent loop + all probes stop.
